note: Read 2026-11-01 at the owner's word ("Build those first 3 starting with ledger first"; of the 21 countries read first: "It should cover across every country"; "Retry the blocked tax facts once all countries land"): the tax on a screen worker's pay in Vietnam: a resident's income tax, social contributions, what is withheld at source, a non-resident artiste's withholding, an author's treatment, VAT and the tax year. Research and retry subagents (workbench/briefs/BRIEF-tax.md, BRIEF-tax-retry.md), every quote checked by the lead against its saved page.

figures.finding: A resident's employment income is taxed monthly at 5% to VND 10 million, 10% to 30 million, 20% to 60 million, 30% to 100 million and 35% above, after a personal deduction of VND 15.5 million a month (VND 6.2 million per dependent) and compulsory insurance contributions; there is no regional layer.

sources.said: Employment income: resident Up to 10 million 5% Over 10 million and up to 30 million 10% Over 30 million and up to 60 million 20% Over 60 million and up to 100 million 30% Over 100 million 35%
Other tax deductions include a personal deduction and a dependent deduction of VND 15.5 million per taxpayer and VND 6.2 million per dependent (subject to frequent adjustments)
private business income with annual revenue exceeding VND 500 million

figures.finding: The employer withholds tax on employment income monthly or quarterly; where there is no labour contract or it runs under three months (a freelance or day engagement), 10% is withheld on any payment of VND 2 million or more.

sources.said: Tax on employment income is withheld by the employer and remitted to the tax authorities on a monthly or quarterly basis.
However, where there is no labor contract or the contractual term is less than three months, the income derived is subject to a flat rate of 10% on payments of VND 2 million and above.

figures.finding: The tax year is generally the calendar year; an individual filing directly must file and pay by the last day of the fourth month after year end (30 April 2027 for 2026).

sources.said: Tax year: The tax year generally is the calendar year.

For individuals who file tax returns directly with the tax authorities, the normal deadline for tax return submission and tax payment is the last day of the fourth month following the calendar year end.

figures.finding: A Vietnamese employee pays 8% social, 1.5% health and 1% unemployment insurance; the employer 17.5%, 3%, 1% and 0.5% accident insurance. For a foreign employee, where covered, the employer pays 17.5% social and 3% health and the employee 8% and 1.5%.

sources.said: For Vietnamese employees, the employer is required to make SI, HI, UI, and labor accident and occupational disease insurance contributions of 17.5%, 3%, 1%, and 0.5% (0.3% for special cases with official approval), respectively. Vietnamese employees are required to make SI, HI, and UI contributions at rates of 8%, 1.5%, and 1% of the employee’s salary, allowances, and other additional income, respectively.
For foreign employees, in certain circumstances, the employer is required to contribute to HI at a rate of 3% and to SI at a rate of 17.5% (17.3% for special cases with official approval).
Foreign employees are required to make HI contributions at a rate of 1.5% in certain circumstances and retirement and death fund contributions for SI at a rate of 8%.

figures.finding: A non-resident's employment income from Vietnam is taxed at a flat 20%, withheld at source.

sources.said: Employment income of nonresidents is subject to a flat rate of 20%.

figures.finding: Royalties paid to an individual, resident or not, bear a 5% withholding.
figures.applies: Royalty payments (a writer's or director's rights) to individuals.

sources.said: A 5% withholding tax rate applies to royalties paid to resident and nonresident individuals, while a 10% rate applies to royalties paid to nonresident companies.

figures.finding: Everyone trading taxable services in Vietnam registers for VAT; the standard rate is temporarily 8% to 31 December 2026 (10% for excluded supplies).

sources.said: A temporarily reduced standard rate of VAT of 8% applies to most goods and services until 31 December 2026. For goods and services that are excluded from the temporary reduction, the standard rate of VAT is 10%.
All organizations and individuals carrying on the production or trading of taxable goods and services in Vietnam must register for VAT purposes.
